name: Asana
description: Access Asana’s Work Graph directly from Claude to search, create, update, and track tasks, projects, and goals. Coordinate work across teams while connecting AI insights to real deliverables. Complements your Asana workspace with 30+ tools for seamless work management alongside your team’s existing workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Asana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Asana to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Asana MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Asana scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Asana MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asana lists 15 MCP tools, including create_project_preview, create_task_preview, search_tasks_preview, get_status_overview, get_items_for_portfolio, get_portfolio, get_portfolios, get_project, get_projects, get_task, get_tasks, and get_user.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Asana?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Asana in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Asana requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Asana failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Asana scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Asana is developed by Asana. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
